chunks: We have explained (the truth) in various ways in this Qur'an, that they may be warned; but it only increased their refractoriness.

key_terms.لِيَذَّكَّرُوا: That they may be warned/take heed

ai.seo_question: Why does the Qur'an explain the truth in various ways yet some people remain refractory?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dialectical nature of divine guidance, where the Qur'an's multifaceted explanations serve as a test of receptivity rather than a uniform solution. While the wise find clarity and spiritual elevation, the stubborn experience increased aversion, illustrating the principle that truth reveals itself according to the listener's inner state. This dynamic underscores the Shia emphasis on contemplation (tafakkur) as the bridge between divine revelation and human understanding.
